title: Find the country of the tallest player who has a vision score above 89. The
question: Find the country of the tallest player who has a vision score above 89. Then, among leagues in that country, return the one with the most draws (tied matches) during the 2015/2016 season.

prediction.sql:
WITH tallest_country AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS country_id
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
  JOIN Match m ON p.XCL_122 = m.XCL_061
  JOIN Country c ON m.XCL_007 = c.XCL_001
  WHERE pa.XCL_160 > 89
  ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM League l
JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
WHERE l.XCL_004 = (SELECT country_id FROM tallest_country)
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND m.XCL_015 = m.XCL_016
GROUP BY l.XCL_005
ORDER BY COUNT(m.XCL_006) DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH tallest AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS country_id
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
  JOIN Match m ON p.XCL_122 = m.XCL_061
  JOIN Country c ON m.XCL_007 = c.XCL_001
  WHERE pa.XCL_160 > 89
  ORDER BY p.XCL_126 DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
draws AS (
  SELECT l.XCL_005 AS league_name, COUNT(m.XCL_006) AS draw_count
  FROM League l
  JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
  WHERE l.XCL_004 = (SELECT country_id FROM tallest)
    AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    AND m.XCL_015 = m.XCL_016
  GROUP BY l.XCL_005
  ORDER BY draw_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT league_name FROM draws
